name: Product Import for Triumph Underwear
author: Keramaros Antonios

sections.description:
This plugin fetches product details like names, descriptions, and images, making them ready for you to customize and sell. Expand your store’s product range with ease and focus on creating an engaging shopping experience for your customers. Perfect for fashion retailers looking to save time and streamline product management.

External Services

This plugin connects to the triumph.keramaros.gr API to retrieve and display product information, including descriptions, images, and metadata. This functionality is essential to ensure the plugin can dynamically present up-to-date product details in your wordpress.

The plugin sends the following information to the API:

  1. API key or authentication credentials (as required by the API).
  2. Request parameters specifying the desired product or category data.

Data is sent every time the plugin queries the API to retrieve or update product information. This typically occurs during:

  • Initial setup of the plugin.
  • User-initiated requests to update or fetch product data.
  • Links to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
  • For more details about how the triumph.keramaros.gr API processes and safeguards data, refer to the following:

Terms of Service https://keramaros.gr/terms-of-use-for-product-import-for-triumph-underwear-api
Privacy Policy https://keramaros.gr/privacy-policy-for-product-import-for-triumph-underwear-api
sections.installation:
Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to install this WordPress plugin:

Via the WordPress Dashboard

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Click Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the downloaded .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, click Activate.

Via FTP

  1. Use an FTP client (like FileZilla) to connect to your WordPress site’s server.
  2. Navigate to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Upload the unzipped plugin folder to this directory.
  4. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard and activate the plugin under Plugins > Installed Plugins.
